style: 地下宫殿，规则柱跨与高拱顶

rules.title: 宫殿
rules.scatter_rule: 规则柱跨基准140U节距乘0.83–1.18；成对柱冠不可分别随机缩放。
rules.junction_rule: 交汇厅单owner，出口之间放柱，公共厅不能叠三张宫殿图。
rules.top_rule: 高拱与装饰柱跨分离；暗部允许相近色背景/雾衔接，明亮拱肩需实际覆盖。

ground.source: design_initial; measure runtime slope before acceptance

lighting.diagnostic: freeze exact camera and simulation; white ambient; fog/virtual lights disabled; bright background
lighting.acceptance: Diagnostic gaps are observations. Accept matched dark background/sky/fog joins when production lighting and supported light changes remain convincing; require local geometry for visibly lit gaps.

examples: plain column arch, carved column arch, damaged column arch
base plinth, rubble, small urn, fallen carving
unlit fixture, sparse lamp, empty niche
kit.root_policy: Two columns share module scale and support plane. Sculpture base defines grounding; niche is attached, never a floor prop.
kit.assembly: Vault surface behind decorative column bays at 5.81-8.26m. The continuous roof closes shoulders and bay gaps. Sparse chandeliers occupy verified roof sockets.
kit.light_fx: Reference gray-green ambient and warm accents. Lamp emissive surface plus shared accent budget; no extra real light for each chandelier.
kit.junction: Single crossing hall with pillars only between protected routes. Do not tile three complete facades across it.
kit.lighting_acceptance: Choose open/atmospheric/hybrid/geometric. Compare diagnostic with production lighting and actual permitted changes before deciding roof asset scope.
